ownerContext: The two large circular openings in the front upright wall are where the ultrasonic module's two transducer cans fit (owner-confirmed assembly relationship, not a dimension).

cardCrossCheck.reading: In photo 01 the card gives the same scale to 0.02 percent, an independent check of the 53.57 mm spacing. In photos 02 and 03 the card stands about 3 percent nearer the camera than the wall and is not used for lengths.

values.note: The M6 trace puts the wall outer face at the deck front edge; the photograph shows a 1.76 mm bend beyond it. A bend outer radius of 1.76 mm also bounds the sheet thickness at or below about 1.76 mm (inner radius cannot be negative).

deckConsistency.grade: Consistency check of the M6 deck trace; its scale is the trace itself, so it is not an independent length

decision.quantity: deck underside (installed; the deck inner face) to wall end-hole centre
decision.derivation: deck outer face to hole centre 12.76 +- 0.35 minus the sheet thickness. The thickness is not measured directly: M6 records 2 mm as PROBABLE, the bend bounds it at or below about 1.76 mm, and the end-portion edge gap gives 1.3 to 1.9 mm. With t in 1.5..2.0 mm the value is 10.76..11.26 mm; the end-portion lower edge read directly gives 11.15 +- 0.3.
decision.reason: The whole uncertainty range lies below the 12.45 mm a 20.5 mm Plate H needs to clear a 2.2 mm horn plate under the deck, by at least 0.8 mm, so the hole line cannot be the input that resolves S09. The best estimate is about 1 mm lower than the trace; that is a refinement, not the remedy. Plate A is not revised.

consequencesForS09.basis: Analytic estimates from the derived values above, not a solid model; Plate A is unchanged in the chain, so the closure still sees the M6 geometry.

items.pair: Plate A vs ultrasonic (crystal against the wall)
items.estimate: Explained by the M6 slot trace: the measured deck-side slot is 5.4 mm tall and spans about 2.95 to 8.34 mm from the deck outer face, against a 4.5 mm crystal spanning about 2.6 to 7.1 mm below the deck underside when the can axes sit on the opening line (0.24 mm beyond the end-hole line). The crystal would pass 0.5 mm beyond the slot's far edge, inside the combined uncertainty of slot edge, crystal width and can offset; the M6 trace left 2.85 mm
Plate H top at about -0.75 mm (11.0 - 10.25) is below the deck underside; no overlap
Board top edge about 2.6 mm below the deck underside, under the 2.2 mm horn plate, and the hub front stays behind the board; no overlap

Plate H top at about -0.75 mm still shares about 1.45 mm of height with the 2.2 mm horn plate. In plan, if the wall outer face is 8.31 mm ahead of the hub (consistency grade) and the sheet about 1.6 to 1.76 mm, the arm front edge clears Plate H and only the 3.85 mm hub disc can reach it, by 0 to about 0.9 mm depending on the unmeasured board and Plate H thicknesses; with the M6 hub-to-wall distance the overlap stays

NEW CONTRADICTION. The openings are 25.85 +- 0.25 mm apart and 17.0 +- 0.4 mm across; the module revision has cans 28.4 +- 0.6 mm apart and 16.6 mm across. Both cans cannot sit in both openings: each would be 1.3 mm off its opening centre against 0.2 mm of radial slack. Only the joint extremes of both uncertainty bands meet.

remainingEvidence: Ultrasonic module: centre-to-centre spacing of the two transducer cans and the can outer diameter, by calipers (or outer edge to outer edge across both cans); the photo-derived 28.4 mm conflicts with the measured 25.85 mm opening spacing and the owner-confirmed fit
Plate A sheet thickness and Plate H thickness, by calipers
Pan-hole centre to the front wall inner face, by calipers along the deck
Module board thickness and the height of its rear components, which set where Plate H rests
Optional: one side-on photograph of the assembled front (deck, horn, module, Plate H) showing whether Plate H's top edge meets the horn hub
